artigo.titulo: How to force hyacinth bulbs for Christmas

legenda: A hyacinth flowering at Christmas is a bulb tricked into thinking winter is over. Missed the start? A pot with tight buds, kept cool, still gets you there this year.

beats.texto: Hyacinths at Christmas?! The secret is a fake winter!
Relax! It's easier than it sounds.
Start in September, with prepared bulbs.
Then a few weeks somewhere cold and dark.
Keep the compost lightly moist. Never soggy.
Shoots a few centimetres tall? Now it goes into the light.
Already December?! Buy tight buds and keep them cool.
Check the soil first. Water when it's dry on top.
Every plant is different. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
